list.title: Interfaces
list.description: Views to explore and act on your data: pages and their building blocks.

pages.title: Pages
pages.emptyDescription: A page shows lists, records and forms. Ask your AI to create one, for example: “create a page to track my leads”.

queries.title: Saved queries
queries.hint: Questions asked of your data, reused by pages.
queries.emptyDescription: A saved query computes a number or a list (e.g. “revenue per month”) so it can be displayed.
